sources.0: Cliopatria v0.2.1 (Seshat Global History Databank), CC BY 4.0: https://github.com/Seshat-Global-History-Databank/cliopatria/blob/v0.2.1/LICENSE.md
sources.1: Archigos 4.1 (Goemans, Gleditsch and Chiozza), whose page states no licence and asks users to “cite this article as their reference for the data” (Journal of Peace Research 46(2), 2009); kept until VM’s owner decides, for which leader is counted and how each took and left office, which no free source records: https://www.rochester.edu/college/faculty/hgoemans/data.htm
sources.statehood: Wikidata (CC0): each state’s inception (P571), dissolution (P576) and “instance of sovereign state” (P31, P580) statements, and those of the items it replaced and that replaced it (P1365, P1366); the picks that are not the single preferred value are listed in scripts/build-statehood.mjs
sources.leaders: Names and dates: Wikidata (CC0), the person’s “position held” (P39) statement, where its dates agree with Archigos 4.1 within 31 days (source "Wikidata", with the item, named by the title of the English Wikipedia article the item links to, and Archigos’s own dates and earlier name kept in archigos); otherwise Archigos 4.1 (source "Archigos"). Which leader is counted, and entry, exit and exitHow: Archigos 4.1, to 2015. After 2015: Wikidata (CC0). The eleven hand-built lists (source "leader-lists"): scripts/leader-lists.mjs, which names its sources
sources.parties: Wikidata "member of political party" (P102), matched to time in office
